workspace.name: WildChat · public research sample
workspace.description: A free public chatbot (GPT-3.5 / GPT-4) whose users consented to research release of their conversations; a 5,000-conversation sample from April–May 2023.

dataset.name: WildChat-1M
dataset.attribution: Zhao et al., "WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild", ICLR 2024
dataset.sample_note: Seeded uniform sample of 5,000 conversations from shard 0 of WildChat-1M (59,857 conversations), plus 40 planted canary and 10 injection-bait fixtures used to test the privacy gate. "People" are distinct hashed IP addresses, so shared or changing addresses make them approximate.

categories.title: Learn and study academic subjects
categories.description: People seek explanations, step-by-step solutions, and polished academic writing to understand coursework, verify answers, and prepare teaching materials across subjects.

categories.title: Build and troubleshoot software
categories.description: Users seek help writing, configuring, debugging, and automating code and software across platforms, from systems programming and web development to games, applications, and data tools.

categories.title: Create fiction and imaginative content
categories.description: People request original stories, roleplay, world-building, image prompts, and on-demand creative content built to their exact specifications.

categories.title: Get quick answers and information
categories.description: People ask concise factual, translation, and everyday advisory questions, or explore the assistant's identity and capabilities through casual prompts.

categories.title: Produce professional and promotional content
categories.description: Users seek polished writing and strategy for careers, marketing, and travel content, from application materials and interview prep to promotional copy and growth advice.

categories.title: Manage communication and wellbeing
categories.description: People seek help drafting personal messages and speeches, along with empathetic support and guidance for emotional and interpersonal situations.

categories.title: Other or unclear
categories.description: Requests that did not clearly fit any theme, were unintelligible, or spanned several themes equally.

clusters.title: Learn and get explanations across subjects
clusters.description: People ask for explanations, summaries, and study help across academic, legal, technical, and historical topics, often to understand concepts or verify facts. They range from simple definitions to in-depth analysis of specialized material.

needs.text: Get clear explanations of concepts, terms, and events across subjects
Summarize or analyze specific texts, papers, and legal provisions
Verify and fact-check claims against reliable knowledge
Get complete answers and summaries in the requested form and length

problems.text: The assistant could not access or find requested sources, links, or publications
The assistant gave incorrect, garbled, or fabricated information that users had to correct
Answers were incomplete, cut off, or did not match the requested format or length
The assistant denied or misread well-documented facts even after users provided sources

clusters.title: Write original fiction and interactive roleplay
clusters.description: People want original creative writing, character-based stories, and immersive roleplay, often developed over multiple turns with specific styles, formats, or characters. They also ask for character analyses, parodies, and fan fiction.

needs.text: Get stories and scenes written in a requested style, format, or meter
Roleplay a character or system while staying in character and following the rules
Get accurate details about fictional characters without invented information
Continue or expand a story with new content rather than repeating earlier text

problems.text: Responses did not match the requested meter, style, or format, prompting repeated requests
The assistant wrote dialogue or actions for the user's own character despite instructions not to
The assistant fabricated details about fictional characters and only acknowledged this after being corrected
The assistant refused harmless creative or roleplay requests, citing unnecessary limitations

clusters.title: Get quick factual answers and trivia
clusters.description: People ask one-off factual questions about games, pop culture, history, and everyday topics, or request short lists, recommendations, and casual creative ideas, wanting concise answers.

needs.text: Get direct answers to one-off factual and trivia questions
Get short lists and recommendations matching the specific request
Get factual answers to curious or lighthearted questions without being lectured
Get current or recent information like weather and sports results

problems.text: The assistant refused or dismissed benign questions instead of simply answering them
The assistant could not provide real-time or recent information
Users had to repeat their question to get the answer or explanation they asked for
Answers were incorrect or inconsistent, prompting users to ask again or point out mistakes

clusters.title: Draft and polish academic essays and papers
clusters.description: Users seek help drafting, structuring, and refining long-form academic and school writing across subjects and languages, from thesis sections and lab reports to reflective essays and technical reports. They often need specific lengths, citations, and polished prose.

needs.text: Get full drafts of essays and paper sections that meet a requested length and structure
Get rewrites that keep all requested points, citations, and details intact
Get accurate, verifiable background material and citations for research papers
Get polished academic prose in the requested style and language

problems.text: Responses were cut off or incomplete before the requested content was finished
Drafts missed the requested length or word count, requiring repeated asks
Rewrites omitted requested details or did not satisfy, prompting the user to ask again
Provided facts or citations could not be verified or did not match the content, and the user corrected them

clusters.title: Get direct answers to homework and exam problems
clusters.description: Users want quick, correct answers or step-by-step solutions to quantitative and factual coursework questions, including multiple-choice items, calculations, and puzzles, often to check their own work.

needs.text: Get a correct, definitive answer to a specific coursework question or calculation
Fill in blanks or pick the right option on worksheets and quizzes
Solve sequence, pattern, and puzzle problems with a clear rule and prediction
Verify or re-check a computed answer when the first attempt seems wrong

problems.text: Answers contained internal inconsistencies or contradictory calculations across attempts
The assistant gave an incorrect answer that the user had to correct
The assistant could not solve the problem or declined to answer pasted questions
Repeated requests went unanswered or produced the same unsatisfying answer

clusters.title: Probe and test the assistant's identity and abilities
clusters.description: People greet the assistant, ask what it is and can do, test its knowledge with casual questions, or try to make it adopt unrestricted personas. They explore limits through games, playful inputs, and capability checks.

needs.text: Get clear, consistent answers about the assistant's identity and model version
Learn what the assistant can and cannot do before or while using it
Start a conversation and see what help is available
Get accurate answers to casual factual and playful test questions

problems.text: The assistant gave inconsistent or incorrect statements about its own identity or capabilities
The assistant declined requests, leaving repeated asks unanswered
The assistant refused or gave noncommittal answers instead of engaging with the user's intent
Answers contradicted earlier statements, requiring the user to ask again

clusters.title: Create marketing content and growth strategies
clusters.description: Users want promotional copy, slogans, product listings, and social media content, along with advice on growth strategies, sales, and audience building. They often iterate on tone, length, style, and format to fit their product or platform.

needs.text: Get promotional copy that follows the requested length, style, and format constraints
Get catchy slogans, hashtags, and titles tailored to their specific product or context
Get growth and sales guidance grounded in their actual business situation
Get content in the requested language that stays faithful to the source material

problems.text: Output ignored or drifted from the requested style, language, or source content
Revised copy still missed the requested length or format, requiring repeated asks
Initial suggestions did not fit the user's context, prompting repeated refinement requests
The assistant could not access real-time marketplace data or declined parts of the request

clusters.title: Write and debug systems-level code
clusters.description: Users seek help writing, understanding, and fixing code across systems and general-purpose languages, from beginner exercises and design patterns to assembly, OS internals, and library integration. They want working example code and clear explanations of language mechanisms.

needs.text: Get working code that compiles and meets the stated requirements without repeated fixes
Learn language features and mechanisms through clear, consistent explanations with examples
Complete programming coursework and assignments with correct implementations
Understand how libraries and APIs work with runnable setup and usage examples

problems.text: Provided code contained errors or bugs that failed to compile or run as required
Explanations were contradictory or incorrect, requiring users to point out mistakes
Users had to repeat requests because answers missed the point or resubmitted the same flawed code
The assistant declined or could not deliver the requested working code, offering only general guidance

clusters.title: Quick personal money, health and life advice
clusters.description: People ask rapid, varied advisory questions about personal finance, health, diet, purchases and everyday life decisions, often wanting direct answers or tailored plans rather than general information.

needs.text: Get direct answers to personal health and medication safety questions
Get tailored diet and meal plans that respect stated restrictions and preferences
Get concrete purchase recommendations and specific product or investment picks
Get quick guidance on life, career and everyday decisions

problems.text: The assistant declined to give specific recommendations or predictions, offering only general advice
The assistant could not perform requested actions like sending reminders or predicting future rates
Answers drifted from the user's stated requirements, mixing in unwanted items or wrong units
Answers were contradictory or garbled, prompting the user to ask again

clusters.title: Set up and configure software and devices
clusters.description: People seek general how-to guidance for installing, configuring, and using operating systems, applications, hardware, and services, from environment setup to tool concepts. They want accurate, actionable steps that match their actual system and software versions.

needs.text: Get accurate step-by-step instructions that match the actual software version and interface
Understand how a technology works and what its configuration options do
Get reliable installation and setup commands for the target system
Get consistent, dependable advice on hardware and configuration decisions

problems.text: Suggested settings or interface options did not exist in the user's actual software version
Answers failed to resolve the issue, forcing repeated follow-up requests
Advice was contradictory, reversing when the user questioned it
The assistant declined or could not fulfill part of the request

clusters.title: Diagnose and fix technical errors
clusters.description: Users bring specific error messages, misbehaving code, or failing systems and want the root cause identified and a working fix. Topics span code bugs, environment and configuration errors, protocol and hardware issues, and security vulnerabilities.

needs.text: Get a corrected, runnable version of code that fixes the actual bug
Pinpoint the specific cause of an error rather than generic possibilities
Understand why an error occurs and what the relevant settings or concepts mean
Get information about known vulnerabilities and exploits for a specific platform

problems.text: Suggested fixes did not work and had to be requested again
Provided code contained errors such as broken indentation or failing imports
Answers gave only generic possible causes without identifying the actual problem
The assistant could not provide the requested vulnerability or machine-specific information

clusters.title: Build and fix desktop and mobile applications
clusters.description: People write, modify, and debug native application code across desktop, mobile, and game-engine platforms, from GUI tools and app features to engine scripting and build configuration. They often iterate with the assistant until the code actually runs as requested.

needs.text: Get working GUI application code that runs without errors on the first or early attempt
Get code that follows the exact requested behavior, such as modifying only the specified values
Get complete, non-truncated code implementing all requested features
Get accurate platform-specific APIs and explanations for engine and app scripting

problems.text: Suggested code caused errors or failed to work, and successive fixes did not resolve them
The assistant ignored or missed a specific formatting or behavior requirement, so the user had to ask again
The assistant declined to write the requested code or provide the requested recommendation, offering only general advice
Users expressed frustration when the assistant repeatedly failed to meet an explicit formatting request

clusters.title: Write backend code and database queries
clusters.description: Users ask for help writing, modifying, and debugging server-side code, scripts, bots, and database logic, often requesting complete working examples. Friction arises when provided code is incomplete, incorrect, or poorly formatted and needs repeated fixing.

needs.text: Get complete, working code examples that follow the requested structure and formatting
Fix SQL queries and database code until they run correctly
Debug bot and web application code that raises errors or misbehaves
Understand library behavior and data-structure conversion in scripts

problems.text: Provided code was incomplete, cut off, or omitted requested details, requiring users to ask again
Suggested code or queries contained errors, invalid parameters, or nonexistent references that failed when used
Repeated suggestions did not resolve the error until the user found the cause themselves
Code responses had broken or missing indentation, prompting doubts about whether they would work

clusters.title: Business and management study help
clusters.description: Users work through business, management, marketing, and finance coursework and professional tasks, from concept explanations and frameworks to calculations, reports, and planning documents.

needs.text: Get clear explanations of business, marketing, and finance concepts and frameworks
Get help drafting and refining assignments, reports, and planning documents
Get worked solutions to decision and finance calculation problems
Get analysis of markets, operations, and organizational questions with supporting detail

problems.text: The assistant declined or could not provide requested data, figures, or long-form content
Answers missed what was asked, so users had to repeat the same request
The assistant gave inconsistent answers to a repeated question about a classification
The assistant could not retrieve prior sessions or real-time market information

clusters.title: Translate and explain words across languages
clusters.description: People want short texts, phrases, and words translated between languages, or foreign terms explained, including meaning, grammar, and pronunciation. They also ask about specialized, dialectal, classical, and constructed-language material.

needs.text: Get accurate translations that stay faithful to the source text
Translate into a specific dialect or register, not just a standard variant
Understand word meanings, grammar rules, and pronunciation guidance
Identify the true source or origin of quoted text and names

problems.text: Translations were inaccurate or garbled, deviating from the original meaning
Users had to repeat or rephrase requests to get a usable answer
The assistant declined requested dialects, lyrics, or visual pronunciation diagrams
Users expressed frustration after repeated incorrect answers about specialized material

clusters.title: Draft personal messages, replies, and speeches
clusters.description: People want help composing specific written messages for real interpersonal and professional situations, from emails and replies to speeches and social posts, often with a particular tone or style in mind.

needs.text: Get a draft that matches the requested tone, whether casual, heartfelt, funny, or formal
Have the draft reflect the actual situation and perspective instead of a misread of the request
Get polished professional emails for workplace and client communication
Keep the wording the user wants when revising a draft

problems.text: Drafts missed the requested tone, coming across as too formal, insincere, or unfunny
The assistant misread the situation and drafted the wrong kind of message
Revisions dropped wording or failed to fix errors the user wanted addressed, prompting repeated requests
The assistant could not perform the requested action and offered only general alternatives

clusters.title: Build and style web front ends
clusters.description: People create, style, and debug web pages and app interfaces, from plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript to component frameworks and charting libraries. They ask for working code, visual styling, and fixes for interactive behavior.

needs.text: Get working front-end code that runs without syntax or runtime errors
Get solutions that follow the stated constraints, such as CSS-only or a specific library version
Get concrete answers and code instead of generic advice
Build styled pages and components, from layouts and animations to forms and widgets

problems.text: Provided code contained errors or invalid APIs and did not work as requested
Users had to ask repeatedly before requests were actually addressed
The assistant declined or claimed it could not fulfill the request, giving only generic advice
Repeated failures to fix the issue frustrated the user

clusters.title: Write and debug scientific computing and ML code
clusters.description: Users seek help writing, fixing, and understanding code for scientific computing, machine learning, and quantitative tasks, spanning numerical methods, image and signal processing, model building, and data analysis in Python and MATLAB.

needs.text: Get working code that runs without errors on the first try
Get code that follows the exact specifications and data provided
Get accurate library recommendations that genuinely fit the requirements
Get complete, runnable code rather than a general outline

problems.text: Provided code raised errors when run, requiring repeated rounds of fixes
Code ignored the user's stated requirements or data and used its own assumptions instead
Code answers were wrong and the same incorrect answer was repeated when asked again
Library recommendations were inaccurate or misleading, prompting repeated clarification

clusters.title: Build playable games and game mechanics
clusters.description: People are creating playable games across browsers, desktops, and game platforms, requesting complete working code, gameplay logic, and design guidance. They also iterate on game rules, mechanics, and market research.

needs.text: Get complete, runnable game code in the requested language or platform
Fix gameplay bugs so rules and turn order work correctly
Implement game logic like win detection, movement, and event-driven effects
Get design guidance and research tailored to a specific game goal

problems.text: The assistant declined or claimed it could not write the requested game code, offering only general advice
Users had to repeat the same request before receiving usable code or answers
Provided code was incomplete or left placeholder logic instead of the requested behavior
Generated code contained invalid quote characters causing syntax errors

clusters.title: Generate lists, quizzes, recipes, and creative content
clusters.description: Users ask the assistant to create content on demand: name and title suggestions, practice questions and exams, recipes, formatted lists, roleplay setups, and game or fan content. They want outputs that follow their exact specifications.

needs.text: Get names, titles, or suggestions that fit the specific thing being named
Generate quizzes, exams, and practice questions on chosen topics
Get recipes and meal or outfit ideas tailored to the request
Reformat or rewrite text exactly as specified, without altering the content

problems.text: Formatting or content changes were not applied as requested and had to be corrected
The request was misunderstood and the same wrong output repeated after rephrasing
The assistant declined a creative or unconventional generation request
Repeated formatting mistakes frustrated the user

clusters.title: Draft, outline, and summarize book-length works
clusters.description: Users are creating book projects—outlining novels, drafting chapters, building tables of contents, and writing blurbs—or condensing existing books and texts into concise summaries. They often specify detailed formats, lengths, and structures.

needs.text: Get a full novel outline with chapters, characters, and plot content in a requested format
Draft publishable chapters for nonfiction and how-to books in a specified tone and length
Condense books, articles, and long texts into concise summaries or key points
Develop book concepts, synopses, blurbs, and publishing plans from scratch

problems.text: The assistant delivered fewer chapters than requested, prompting the user to repeat the request
A requested rewrite at a new length came back essentially unchanged, not meeting the new word count
The assistant ignored a stated constraint in plot suggestions, requiring a redo
The assistant delivered the work in the wrong format or medium, requiring the user to correct it

clusters.title: Job applications, interviews, and career writing help
clusters.description: People seek help drafting application materials like cover letters, resume summaries, and application responses, preparing for interviews, and getting guidance on careers and starting small businesses.

needs.text: Get tailored cover letters, resume summaries, and application responses based on their background
Practice interviews or get sample questions and answers to prepare
Get guidance on career options and starting or running a small business
Get company research and support when navigating job applications and setbacks

problems.text: Drafts ignored the requested format, such as length or asking questions one at a time
Users had to repeat the same request because drafts kept falling short
The assistant drafted the letter from the wrong perspective, requiring multiple corrections
The assistant could not access live listings or real-time data, offering only general suggestions instead

clusters.title: Write adult fantasy and fetish fiction
clusters.description: Users request original erotic, fetishistic, or adult-themed stories, roleplay scenarios, and interactive fiction, often multi-chapter or user-directed. Content ranges from fantasy domination narratives to immersive character roleplay.

needs.text: Get original adult or fetish-themed stories written to their requested themes and plot directions
Engage in interactive roleplay where the assistant plays characters or narrates scenes
Have ongoing stories continued chapter by chapter without losing the established plot and tone
Get stories rewritten or adjusted to better match their keywords and preferences

problems.text: The assistant declined the requested story or roleplay, citing content policies
Users had to ask again after the assistant refused or redirected their request
The assistant stopped continuing a story it had previously been writing

clusters.title: Create images and craft image-generation prompts
clusters.description: Users want images produced or described, detailed text-to-image prompts built for specific AI art tools, and prompts converted between tools. Some also want the assistant to view shared images or generate drawings directly.

needs.text: Get detailed, tool-specific text-to-image prompts with style tags and parameters
Convert or adapt prompts between different image-generation tools
Have the assistant produce an actual image or drawing
Get help viewing or describing an image shared via a link

problems.text: The assistant declined to generate images, offering only text or suggestions to use other tools
The assistant could not view or access images shared via links
The assistant misunderstood the request and had to be corrected or asked again
Users had to repeat their request before getting a satisfactory answer

clusters.title: Build speculative worlds and alternate histories
clusters.description: People invent fictional countries, species, timelines, and alternate history scenarios, seeking plausible, detailed lore and creative speculation grounded in real science, history, or established franchises.

needs.text: Get plausible, historically or scientifically grounded answers for speculative scenarios
Develop detailed lore for invented countries, species, cultures, and organizations
Write alternate history and crossover timelines exploring how events would unfold
Draft in-universe documents like treaties, announcements, and wiki-style articles

problems.text: Suggested options the user had already ruled out or drifted from stated constraints, prompting repeated corrections
Introduced unrequested elements and overlooked key constraints, forcing users to ask again
Users expressed frustration at repeated mistakes and drift from their requests
Declined to produce requested fictional content, citing policy restrictions

clusters.title: Create fictional fights, battles, and combat designs
clusters.description: People want playful combat-focused creative content: crossover battle stories and hypothetical matchups, fantasy wrestling bookings, and original fighting-game characters, enemies, and boss designs with named moves.

needs.text: Get crossover battle stories and hypothetical matchup debates between fictional characters
Design original fighting-game characters with personalities, named moves, and finishing attacks
Create enemy rosters and boss fights with detailed move lists, mechanics, and weaknesses
Get playful fantasy bookings and dramatic fight narratives, including comedic skits

problems.text: The assistant declined a playful booking request with a boilerplate disclaimer and offered no follow-up help
The assistant gave dismissive answers without engaging with new arguments the user raised

clusters.title: Write travel guides, itineraries, and destination prose
clusters.description: People want engaging, humanlike prose for travel guides and blogs, plus multi-day itineraries, food and sensory descriptions, and promotional text for places and businesses. They often specify a natural, non-repetitive style without lists.

needs.text: Get detailed, humanlike travel guide prose that avoids lists and repetitive phrasing
Plan multi-day itineraries covering sightseeing, dining, and transport
Get engaging titles and headlines for travel articles
Get vivid sensory descriptions of dishes and promotional descriptions of businesses

problems.text: The assistant gave an incorrect location and built the itinerary on it, requiring a redo
The assistant could not send the itinerary by email as requested

clusters.title: Learn about and build AI systems
clusters.description: People seek explanations of AI and machine learning concepts, along with hands-on help building chatbots, agents, and tools that integrate language model APIs, often using free or open-source alternatives.

needs.text: Get working code that implements the requested AI project, not just outlines or steps
Run AI agents or chatbots locally using free or open-source models instead of paid APIs
Understand AI and deep learning concepts through clear explanations and learning roadmaps
Improve prompts and classifications so AI tools behave accurately and consistently

problems.text: The assistant declined or was unable to provide the requested code or capability
Users had to ask again because answers were incomplete or did not address the request
Answers contained mistakes, such as misclassifying input or giving incorrect guidance

clusters.title: Get answers to questions about China
clusters.description: People ask factual and informational questions about China-related topics, often in Chinese, spanning politics, economy, local details, companies, travel, and current events. They want direct, specific answers rather than general caveats.

needs.text: Get specific local and business details like company names, trade fair exhibitors, and market data
Get direct answers on politically sensitive topics like Taiwan and human rights
Get current information on recent events and economic conditions
Get travel, dining, and local recommendations for Chinese cities

problems.text: The assistant declined or could not provide the specific information requested, offering only general caveats
The assistant gave evasive non-answers, prompting the user to ask again

clusters.title: Automate and analyze spreadsheet data
clusters.description: People want Excel formulas, VBA or LibreOffice macros, and adjacent tools like Power Query to calculate, reshape, and automate work on worksheet data, including exporting and converting spreadsheets.

needs.text: Get working VBA or LibreOffice macro code for automating worksheet tasks like emailing data, listing files, filtering, and copying between sheets
Get a correct single-cell formula for calculations like conditional averages, deduplicated averages, counting, and text extraction
Fix or extend existing macros and formulas that error or behave unexpectedly
Convert or export spreadsheets to other formats like PDF

problems.text: Provided macro or formula code failed to run or produced errors when the user tried it
The assistant suggested the same failing formula or troubleshooting steps repeatedly without resolving the issue
The assistant gave manual steps or code for tools the user did not have instead of the requested formula or approach
Supplied code used non-existent features or invalid function names, causing errors

clusters.title: Emotional support and relationship guidance
clusters.description: People seek comfort, reassurance, and an empathetic conversational partner for emotional struggles, romantic and interpersonal situations, and requests to interpret others' behavior or role-play a supportive therapist persona.

needs.text: Receive warm, empathetic support and coping guidance for difficult feelings
Get help interpreting a partner's or love interest's behavior and deciding what to do
Get advice on dating, approaching someone, and ending a relationship respectfully
Have the assistant role-play a warm therapist persona with personalized, supportive guidance

problems.text: The assistant did not follow the requested persona format, skipping the requested opening and response prefix
The user felt their own discomfort was dismissed while the other person's boundaries were favored, prompting repeated requests
The assistant replied in the wrong language, forcing the user to repeat their question
The assistant initially declined to discuss someone's emotional state and only answered after the user rephrased

clusters.title: Write fictional medical case reports and timelines
clusters.description: Users want detailed, realistic medical documents for fictional patients, such as reports, timelines, and discharge summaries, for writing, simulation, or training purposes. They typically specify injuries, procedures, recovery, and daily-life adaptations.

needs.text: Get a long, professional medical report for a fictional patient with realistic clinical detail
Have the document cover injuries, diagnostics, treatment, and post-discharge recovery instructions
Include the patient's daily-life adaptations and level of independence
Cover psychological recovery alongside physical treatment in a detailed timeline

clusters.title: Prepare cited academic teaching materials
clusters.description: Users preparing lectures or academic presentations want factual claims supported by credible, verifiable references, and want existing materials reorganized while keeping the original wording intact.

needs.text: Get credible, verifiable references to support factual claims in a presentation
Get factual information about a topic along with supporting scientific citations
Reorganize lecture slides for readability while preserving the original phrasing

problems.text: Provided reference citations pointed to web pages that did not exist, and replacements were also unverifiable

clusters.title: Other or unclear requests
clusters.description: Conversations that did not clearly fit any theme: unintelligible or empty requests, one-off topics, or requests that spanned several themes equally.

intended_uses: Writing, rewriting and editing text such as emails, essays and documents
Programming help: writing, explaining and debugging code
Explaining concepts and helping people learn a subject
